report_topic: Implementation of Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana in Rajasthan
observations_summary: The audit found that the financial and operational turnaround of DISCOMs in Rajasthan under UDAY remained unachieved due to significant delays in debt takeover, non-adherence to financial provisions, and failure to implement key operational milestones like metering and consumer indexing, leading to continued high AT&C losses and ACS-ARR gaps.
